title: Static Three-Bow Vertical-Axis Turbine
description: One complete newly authored static vertical-axis wind-turbine appearance with three continuous outward-bowed thick blades joining lower and upper rotor hubs around one long vertical shaft. Each complete blade has a six-point closed section and twenty connected axial bands; the three bows surround a real open swept-looking interior without a solid rotor disc. Two broad fixed hubs receive the blade ends, and a tapered pedestal joins the complete square finite ground foundation. Unlike the existing horizontal-axis tower/nacelle and radial flat three-blade propeller, the whole rotor architecture is upright and supported at both blade ends. Eight separate closed editable meshes and four constant opaque PBR materials, metres/native Z up/horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Exactly one whole illustrative model and zero scenes. All joins and the rotor are static; no animation, specified aerodynamic profile, continuous swept clearance, power generation, efficiency, wind-speed rating, bearing fit, load, manufacture, engineering or safety claim.
